premise_origin: explicit user authorization of a new hypothesis, not old-FIN derivation
carrier: fixed finite visible states with uniform hidden labelled coordinates in the supplied parent
preparation: stationary supplied visible pi times uniform hidden measure
finite_source_clock: intrinsic discrete steps; no continuous-time intensity formula applied to grid atoms
readout: retained visible coordinates, or counts under the paid symmetry/multiplicity map
limit_clock: rescaled index t=step/c, not physical calibration
derived_rates: Q_xy=K_xy sqrt(pi_y/pi_x), off diagonal; conservative escape diagonal
activity_restriction: sqrt(Q_xy Q_yx)=K_xy; normalized labelled activity 1 for the primary unweighted support
count_rates: n_a exp((h_b-h_a)/2), with reverse departure multiplicity retained
path_payment: fixed-horizon J1 coupling and full grid-record TV error; not full continuous-path TV
completion_guard: general pairs (K,D) transform jointly; primary D=I unchanged
